{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are too slow to react to sentiment shifts, showing lag of 1-2 forecast steps",
    "Sentiment strength directly correlates with forecast bias - high sentiment (1.0) yields 0.3-0.5 CPI higher than low sentiment (0.0)",
    "Mean reversion bias exists in model outputs, particularly at forecast horizons beyond 15 days where prices converge toward current levels",
    "Sentiment momentum is missing - model doesn't capture accelerating/decelerating sentiment patterns",
    "Price level matters for forecast accuracy - low price bands (under 70) show 0.25-0.35 CPI bias while high bands (above 75) show 0.30-0.40 CPI bias",
    "Model overconfident in sentiment direction - uses linear extrapolation instead of diminishing returns for extreme sentiment values",
    "Forecast volatility underestimates true price volatility by 15-25% across all sentiment conditions"
] }
